WF-03, step 7 gate (WF-02 step 5b), the THIRD EXTRA pass allowed by the owner (decisions/0102 Addition 15) after the FAIL of the second extra pass (a FAIL here goes to the owner) - TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR: check the tests of requirement REQ-102 (defect ISS-0093) after the rework of step 08m (handoffs/ISS-0093-20261028-01/step-08m-test-designer.json; the exhaustive slot rule), reading the earlier gate reports step-08b, step-08e, step-08h, step-08j, step-08l-test-design-validator.json (findings and issues) and judging the rework against them, but run your own full check, not only those points. The tests: tools/test/team-result-bytes.test.js (55 tests; the designer claims 430 sweeps and 393,699 sweep rows, 573 stored and 506 refused rows, 605 pairs, a table of 28 enumerated positions in result.positions of step 08m, and a mechanical generator of three sets of classes; 15,970 mutants over all sets, every survivor named). The new sweeps take their expected side from a REFERENCE predicate written in the test from the requirement's definitions: judge it (AP-071) - is it an independent reading of the requirement text, or the code's own reading copied? Compare it with the requirement words position by position and try inputs where a reading could differ, tools/test/team-result-timing.test.js (14 tests: criterion 7), tools/test/fixtures/team/scenario-secret.json (new), tools/test/fixtures/team/scenario-files.json (edited), and the guard tests edited by the 'was -> became' table in team-store.test.js, team-engine-reads-files.test.js, team-engine-rounds.test.js, team-journal.test.js, exec-workdir.test.js, exec-scripted-source.test.js. Read your role file, docs/quality-bar.md, docs/workflows/WF-03-defect.md (step 7), docs/workflows/WF-02-development.md (step 5b), docs/workflows/handoffs.md, docs/anti-patterns.md (AP-110: test the class of a rule, not the example; check each position of the designer's table: a slot hidden by neighbouring text, a set tested by examples only, a count with no n-1 and n+1), the REQ-102 block by id (criteria 1-12, the table 'was -> became', mutants m1-m45, sample groups, forms F1-F9, the placeholder rules), the design (the requirement wins where they differ), decisions/0102 and 0105, the code diff `git diff -- tools/src tools/README.md`. The code is unchanged since the first gate.
Check with your OWN runs: (1) the criterion -> test mapping for criteria 1-12, any criterion with no test or a weak one; (2) the whole set (bytes, timing, six guard files) on a copy of the whole working tree outside the project in the scratch folder: each file alone in a fresh process and together, at least 3 runs in a row (the timing file alone and not beside other heavy work: the instrument is known to give false reds at about 2x CPU oversubscription, F7 of the previous pass; run nothing heavy beside it), flaky tests, no port, no clock, no order dependence, unique temp folders cleaned; (3) no skip, no todo, no `|| true`, no turned-off lint rule; oracles independent of the code under test (AP-071); no key-shaped literal; the new rows against the RULE text of the requirement (each added row and sweep predicate: is the expected side what the requirement says? the designer reports three own oracle corrections, I1 of step 08k: judge them); (4) failure tests check the state did not change; (5) the criterion 9 numbers recomputed on the final files; (6) regression: the tests fail on a clean copy of the tag base/ISS-0093-20261028-01 with the tests overlaid (no git checkout, reset, stash or clean, also not in copies); (7) apply mutants YOURSELF on a copy outside the project: at least ten of the design's m1-m45, the nine mutants x54, y22-y25, y19, y20, z01b, z02 of step 08l and the seven of step 08j (they must now be red), and at least TWENTY-FIVE NEW mutants of your own that are not in any earlier report, chosen by the CLASS of each rule of forms F1-F9 and of the placeholder rules (every rule stated as «starts with», «ends with», «the whole value», «only of», «optional one», «a run of», «without regard to case», «at least n», «at most n», a boundary character): for each rule try its looser and its tighter neighbour (contains, first k, last k, exactly one, any number, off-by-one in a count, case-sensitive); report which test kills each and every survivor; (8) the criterion 7 instrument: time of the timing file alone, thresholds unchanged, the control separated, the early abandonment equal to the median rule; (9) the deviations: criterion 7 in a second file, scenario-files.json edited (EX-51 row), the amended criteria 1 and 7, TM-57 split. Verdict PASS or FAIL with findings by severity (Critical, High and Medium block; Low does not), each with place, evidence and fix. Do not edit any project file; write only your handoff. Work only inside the Sai folder and the scratch folder: do not read, list or count files of other folders. The scratch folder is the only place for copies, clones and temp files: no files in the system temp folder (set TMPDIR to a scratch sub-folder before any run); no git checkout, reset, stash or clean, also not in copies; leave no process running (ps before you finish). No machine paths and no names of other projects in the handoff, also not inside search patterns (the traces check scans it); no secret-shaped literal. Do not touch ports 4780, 4781, 4782, 4790 (list the Pixel Office test files that bind their own ports and that you did not run). Do not run the full `npm run check` in the project folder (TEST-RUNNER does); no run longer than ten minutes. result.summary: two or three plain Russian sentences for the owner.
